session.disclaimer: This is an educational simulation, not emergency guidance. FloodGuard is a simplified teaching simulation. Its water levels, outcomes and scores are invented and are not a flood forecast or a real-world plan. Characters are fictional and AI-generated text can be wrong. If you are in a real emergency or a flood is happening near you, stop playing and call 112 (India emergency number). Follow instructions from your local authorities and official sources for your area (for example the India Meteorological Department, the Central Water Commission and your State Disaster Management Authority). Do not rely on this simulation for decisions about evacuation, safety or health.

cited_rulecards.title: Safe Shelter Operations
cited_rulecards.guidance: Designate and unlock multi-story masonry public buildings on elevated ground as relief shelters before evacuees arrive to ensure orderly intake and security.

cited_rulecards.title: Early Public Warning Protocol
cited_rulecards.guidance: Broadcast official evacuation advisories promptly when river forecasts suggest imminent bank overtopping. Early warnings give vulnerable families critical lead time to assemble emergency kits and move to higher ground.

cited_rulecards.title: Keep Urban Drains Clear
cited_rulecards.guidance: Blocked storm drains turn heavy rain into street flooding within minutes. Clearing choke points before and during a cloudburst, and keeping people out of underpasses, reduces the danger.

cited_rulecards.title: Requesting Outside Support Early
cited_rulecards.guidance: District and state teams need time to reach a village. Request outside support as soon as local resources look insufficient, rather than when they have run out.

cited_rulecards.title: Vehicle Safety in Floodwaters
cited_rulecards.guidance: Do not dispatch standard wheeled motor vehicles through roads with moving floodwaters deeper than knee level. Use boats or high-clearance specialized equipment when roads submerge.
cited_rulecards.source_reference: Transport and Road Safety Flooding Guidelines
